rows.behavior: The openviking_tools provider sends nothing to OpenViking on its own: prefetch returns empty, and sync_turn, on_session_end, on_session_switch and on_memory_write reach no client.
rows.fails_when: prefetch returns any text, or any of those hooks makes a request through the client.

rows.behavior: Startup recovers and commits no leftover session.
rows.fails_when: initialize, with a stale pending-session marker present, makes a commit or any session request.

rows.behavior: The six viking_* tools keep upstream's schemas and their calls reach OpenViking.
rows.fails_when: the tool schemas differ from upstream's, or a viking_search call does not reach the client.

rows.behavior: Hermes's config selects memory.provider openviking_tools with no recall block, the image copies the wrapper beside the upstream plugin, and hermes_version is 0.22.2-2.
rows.fails_when: the config names another provider or still carries memory.openviking recall settings, the Dockerfile does not copy the wrapper to /opt/hermes/plugins/memory/openviking_tools, or the version pin differs.

rows.behavior: SOUL.md no longer tells Hermes to search OpenViking at conversation start or to save memories after replies.
rows.fails_when: SOUL.md still has a Session Bootstrap section or an Auto-Capture Protocol section.

rows.behavior: The Claude Code how-to removes the auto-capture memory plugin and points to explicit CLI use, in the how-to skeleton.
rows.fails_when: the page still tells readers to install the memory plugin, lacks the uninstall and check steps, or breaks the how-to skeleton.

rows.behavior: Live after deploy: a plain Hermes chat turn and /new send no search, session or commit request to OpenViking, while an explicit viking_search still answers.
rows.fails_when: the recorded proxy or OpenViking request evidence after deploy shows a search/sessions/commit request from a plain turn or /new, or the explicit search fails.
